rows.en: ＊＊－　Aboard the Elan Ship,￥　　Narusawa was doing repairs　－
＊Sakaki＊＠０００＿００２I'm sorry. I told them to come.
＊Sakaki＊＠０００＿００６I'm sorry we had to￥deceive you like that.
＊Sakaki＊＠０００＿００７Command decided that would be￥the final exam.＝＠０００＿００８A test of overall judgment in an￥emergency...
＊Narusawa＊＠０００＿０１０Then why wasn't I told?￥I'm the director here!
＊Sakaki＊＠０００＿０１１You ran off before I￥could explain, remember?
＊Sakaki＊＠０００＿０１３I'd appreciate it if you'd￥listen when I call after you.
＊Sakaki＊＠０００＿０１６Still, Narusawa, I think￥everyone saw how much Elan￥means to you.
＊Narusawa＊＠０００＿０１７It's a bit embarrassing to have￥it come across like this, but...＝＠０００＿０１８My hopes for Elan are the same￥as yours.
＊Sakaki＊＠０００＿０１９Everyone left behind is￥counting on Elan.＝＠０００＿０２０We're praying for your success.￥Please... don't forget that.
